$comment: Hand-authored dfd@1 of docs/THREAT-MODEL.md (verified-against 2026-10-20 779588ed). Each node's note and each flow's evidence.refs cite the section it comes from; a ref is the GitHub-style heading anchor. Groups are the trust boundaries the document names (Trust boundaries 1-5) plus the network and the commitwork system boundary. Every flow is witness authored, existence unknown: the threat model was derived from reading code and states that none of its residual risks was exercised as an attack, so no flow here is confirmed by observation. Elements the document marks not determined are unknown. The credential stores carry no flow: the sandbox denies them after every allow.
